algorithm.action_space: one usage count per enumerated maximal-pattern candidate, completed deterministically so every proposal covers the demands
algorithm.baseline: exponential running mean of episode returns, tracked per instance
algorithm.name: REINFORCE with running-mean baseline and standardized advantages
algorithm.reward: verified signed bar reduction of each reviewed step; strict negative penalty for invalid plans
algorithm.sampling: independent Poisson rates emitted by the network, capped by demand bounds
algorithm.update: per-epoch batch score-function ascent on reward-to-go returns with advantages standardized across the epoch
